description: Bundle: runs seo_audit, domain_health_check (WHOIS + DNS: nameservers, A/AAAA, MX, SPF, DMARC), and email_deliverability_check (DKIM, SPF lookup-count, DMARC strength, DNSBL) against a domain in one call, one charge. Cheaper than calling the three tools separately. Each sub-check reports independently, so a failure in one doesn't void the others.

domain.description: Bare domain to report on, e.g. example.com (no scheme/path)

name: domain_report
